evidence.quote: if (existing.some((b) => b.isActive() && b.stay.overlaps(stay))) throw new Error(`Room ${roomId} is already booked`);

answer.rationale: The no-overlap rule for active bookings of a room is decided in the application service by reading Booking state (isActive, stay). Booking and DateRange don't own it, and no Room aggregate or domain policy does either. It is a business invariant, not input parsing. Being in a transaction doesn't make it a mere uniqueness check, so the rule is misplaced.
